extraction_text: Dhritarashtra praises Yudhishthira's qualities and warns that war will destroy the Kuru family.

attributes.action: Warning against war and praise of enemy

extraction_text: Sanjaya criticizes Dhritarashtra for his past mistakes and poor treatment of the Pandavas.

attributes.action: Criticism and reminder of past injustices
attributes.relationships: Sanjaya as advisor to Dhritarashtra, highlighting his failures as father and ruler
attributes.key_plot_point: Recollection of the dice game and mistreatment of Pandavas

extraction_text: The sons of Pritha (Pandavas) conquered the entire earth through their strength and courage and gave it to you, but you claimed it as your own conquest.

attributes.relationships: Pandavas gave conquered land to Duryodhana, who claimed it as his own

extraction_text: Your sons were captured by Gandharva King and sunk into the sea without rescue, but the sons of Pritha saved them.

attributes.relationships: Pandavas rescued their cousins (Kauravas) from Gandharva King

extraction_text: The sons of Pandu were cheated in gambling and forced into forest exile, while you laughed like a child.

attributes.relationships: Duryodhana's faction cheated Pandavas, leading to their exile

extraction_text: Arjuna showers arrows that could dry up the ocean, and he is the best archer with Gandiva bow.
Keshava (Krishna) is the best among all beings, and Sudarshana is the best discus.
Arjuna's banner with monkey emblem shines brightly, and his chariot with white horses flies like the wheel of time to destroy enemies in battle.

attributes.supernatural_elements: Chariot compared to wheel of time

extraction_text: The whole world now belongs to Arjuna, who has Bhima and Arjuna as warriors.
The Kuru army led by Duryodhana will be destroyed by Bhima on the battlefield.
Your sons and their allied kings fear Bhima and will not win.

attributes.relationships: Kauravas are intimidated by Bhima's strength

extraction_text: Various kingdoms (Matsyas, Panchalas, Kekayas, Salvas, Surasenas) no longer respect you and have joined Arjuna, recognizing the wisdom and courage of Pritha's sons.

attributes.relationships: Former allies abandon Duryodhana for Pandavas

extraction_text: Your evil son and his followers should be punished for cheating those who follow dharma and don't deserve death.

attributes.relationships: Duryodhana's actions are condemned as adharma (unrighteous)

extraction_text: During the gambling match, Vidura and I warned you, but now you lament for the sons of Pandu as if hopeless.

attributes.relationships: Sanjaya and Vidura advised Dhritarashtra against the gambling deception
